_readme: Tempo (4217) seed pools. Run: SEED_POOLS=config/tempo.json ./scripts/seed.sh tempo [--broadcast]. IMPORTANT: Tempo gas is paid in pathUSD (ERC-20) and the deployment weth9 (0xBbBc..25Df2) is a routing wrapper only — the seeder's auto-wrap of native does NOT work here. So this config uses a MINT/MINT pool (two fresh test tokens), which needs no wrapped-native. 20 gwei is a NETWORK FLOOR (txs below it are rejected; chains.json sets gasPriceGwei=20). Set TEMPO_RPC_URL in ../.env. priceAperB is a DEMO ratio; amounts are DEMO-scale. NOTE: the routing adapter marks Tempo ready:false pending pathUSD gas-model validation — seeding proves liquidity, but end-to-end quoting/execution on Tempo still needs that validation. To later seed a wrapped-native-paired pool, first acquire/hold the 0xBbBc.. wrapper token and add a WETH-kind pool.

4217.label: tHOOK / tUSDC v2 (Tempo — MINT/MINT, no native wrap)
